name: writing
description: Prose a scanning reader can use. /writing:be-concise puts the bottom line first, cuts words the meaning does not need, and keeps structure scannable and tone factual. Bare, it sets a standing posture; given a target, it reshapes it and reports word counts. For tickets, PR descriptions, changelogs, READMEs, and status updates. Never drops a decision, number, ask, error, or warning. Paraphrases NN/g, GOV.UK, US plain-language guidelines, Google and Microsoft style guides, and BLUF.
